text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Bakushin O! Today's job is super 
important!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The library books reported as 
potentially harmful reading material... 
The two head committee chairpersons were 
to inspect them together, correct?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Perfect! Whether this book becomes a 
forbidden tome at the academy is up to our 
inspection!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright, first up is this! A psycho-horror 
novel: "Feast of the Evil God ~Satan's 
Thrilling Party Trick: Time Sale on Dark 
Sacrifices~".

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Let's see: "Satan, imprisoned in Hell for 
the grave sin of falling flat on his face 
at a drinking party. Grumbling about his 
unfair treatment, he casts a curse upon 
the mortal realm out of spite."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Meanwhile on Earth, after the 
protagonist's affair is exposed, his wife 
sends assassins after him, but thirteen 
apostles born from a curse begin 
committing one gruesome incident after 
another..."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah! Reading nonsense like this is gonna 
make you stupid! I mean, this is 
definitely bad for public morals—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...N-No! As Class Rep, I think it's 
totally A-OK!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Why's that?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I don't understand the fine details at 
all, but this content... I can feel a 
definite Bakushin in it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Like, say, a scene where the car's engine 
won't start, and the hero couple—unluckily 
getting tangled up with a snake around 
their legs—have to flee from a horde of 
zombies in a three-legged race...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"And in the opening, placing total faith 
in the humor of his craft, Mr. Satan 
delivers jokes at full bakushin speed...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Truly Bakushin!! Looking at the big 
picture, I'd say it's a fine book that 
conveys the true spirit of Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... There might be some hidden passion 
in it, but having such a weird book at the 
academy goes against public morals—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Senpai! There might indeed be issues with 
it! However, recklessly banning a story 
that contains valuable lessons isn't the 
right way to go!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"What kind of moral lesson the students 
draw from the story... Isn't that a 
wonderful learning experience in itself?!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, I see. Bakushin O really does have 
some profound things to say!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Oh, you flatter me!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's put that on hold for now! 
Next up is this one! "End of the Century 
Irresponsible Love Legend 666"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listening to this conversation any longer 
felt like it would give me a headache, so 
I decided to leave the area—
